plainLanguage: New Braunfels most likely uses the 2021 International Residential Code, but we could not confirm the ordinance this time. Typical new homes are in R-1A single-family districts or planned developments. Until verified, plan for about a 25 ft front setback, 5 ft sides and 20 ft rear. Part of the city sits over the Edwards Aquifer recharge zone, where state (TCEQ) water-quality rules can limit paving and require special plans - ask us to check your lot. Homes near the Comal or Guadalupe Rivers may need to be raised above flood level. Water and sewer fees come from New Braunfels Utilities.
openQuestions: Edwards recharge-zone extent within city and any city impervious-cover cap
